acceptable_use: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by The Jackson Police Department and is never sold to 3rd parties.
prohibited_uses: Immigration enforcement, traffic enforcement, harrassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), Personal use.
access_policy: All system access requires a valid reason and is stored indefinitely.
hotlist_policy: Hotlist hits are required to be human-verified through various law enforcement information-sharing channels such as NCIC and LEIN.
